full_prompt_en: This is a square, cinematic photographic close-up of an older man in glasses against a nearly black teal background. His head occupies the left and center of the frame, cropped closely at the top, while the right side falls away into an empty band of deep shadow. The face is turned slightly toward the camera but remains guarded and still. Thin metal-rimmed glasses catch a faint line of light around one lens; the eyes behind them are difficult to read. The bridge of the nose, one cheek, and the firm line of the mouth emerge from darkness, while the other side of the face is almost fully swallowed. Sparse gray hair and the outer contour of the ear are visible near the upper edge. Dark clothing merges with the lower background, leaving the illuminated facial planes as the main anchor of the image. A restrained blue-green light from the upper side grazes the forehead and cheek, producing narrow highlights rather than an even portrait illumination. The shadow transition is steep, and the darkest portions retain little surface detail. Subtle photographic grain and a slightly cool haze prevent the limited palette from looking flat. The framing is very tight, with no clear room, props, or writing to explain the situation. The empty right field increases the apparent weight of the man's profile and makes the low light feel deliberate. No sharp colored accents interrupt the blue-black scale. The overall composition is severe and suspenseful, formed by one partial face, a small reflective edge, and a large expanse of darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形的电影感摄影近景，一位戴眼镜的年长男子位于近乎黑色的深青背景前。他的头占据左侧与中央，上方裁切紧密，右侧则退入一带空阔的浓影。面部略朝镜头转来，却保持戒备而静止。细金属镜框在一片镜片周围接到微弱亮线，镜片后面的眼睛不易看清。鼻梁、一侧脸颊和紧抿的嘴线从黑暗中浮现，面部另一侧几乎被完全吞没。稀疏灰发和耳朵外轮廓在上边缘附近可见。深色衣服并入下方背景，让被照亮的面部平面成为画面的主要支点。克制的蓝绿光从上侧擦过额头和脸颊，只留下狭窄高光，并没有均匀照亮整张脸。阴影过渡很陡，最暗部分几乎不保留表面细节。细微照片颗粒与稍冷的朦胧感使有限配色不至于平板。取景极为紧凑，画面没有清楚房间、道具或文字来解释情境。右侧空阔暗域加重了男子侧面形体的分量，也让低照度显得有意安排。蓝黑色阶中没有鲜明彩色强调。整体构图严厉而悬疑，由一张部分显现的脸、细小反光边缘和大片黑暗组成。
style_prompt_en: The photographic style compresses most of its values into blue-black, teal-gray, and charcoal, reserving a narrow luminous range for selected contours. Light enters from one high side and dies quickly, making partial visibility the chief means of shaping depth. Large dark fields are intentionally quiet; fine grain and faint haze keep them tactile without disclosing the full environment. Crisp reflective lines punctuate otherwise soft, shadow-eaten edges. Close cropping gives the illuminated fragment disproportionate visual weight, while an unoccupied area holds the tension. Color accents are rare and subdued, so small changes in cool tone become expressive. The overall treatment is controlled, austere, and suspenseful, with darkness organized as carefully as the light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种摄影风格把大部分明度压缩在蓝黑、青灰和炭色之间，只为选择性轮廓保留狭窄的亮度范围。光从一侧高处进入并迅速消失，使部分可见成为塑造纵深的主要手段。大块暗域有意保持安静；细颗粒与微弱朦胧感令其保有触感，却不揭示完整环境。清楚的反光细线点缀在其余被阴影吞噬的柔软边缘之间。紧凑裁切赋予发亮片段超出比例的视觉重量，空置区域则维持紧张感。彩色强调稀少而低调，因此冷色中的细小变化也具有表现力。整体处理受控、冷峻且悬疑，黑暗与光亮同样经过仔细组织。
theme_en: An older man in glasses emerging from dark teal shadow
theme_zh: 一位戴眼镜的年长男子从深青色阴影中浮现
name: David Fincher
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
